# Field boundaries for Thuringia, Germany

Germany, Thuringia field boundaries (2026) as fiboa GeoParquet + PMTiles, mirrored by Fields of the World from Thüringer Landesamt für Landwirtschaft und Ländlichen Raum. License: DL-DE-BY-2.0.

- Latest: https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/de_th/latest/de_th.parquet
- All editions: s3://ftw/harmonized-field-data/de_th/year=*/*.parquet (S3 via endpoint https://data.source.coop, path style, anonymous; hive_partitioning=true adds `year`)
- CRS EPSG:25832; `metrics:area` in m²; `year` = edition, `id` unique per edition only.
- Columns: collection, tk10, determination:datetime, change, flik, geometry, flik_last_year, id, metrics:area, area_last_year, bnk, afo, bbox
- Docs: https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/de_th/README.md, agent guide https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/de_th/AGENTS.md, STAC https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/de_th/collection.json
